scope: CUDA bridge v2: device-resident weights — eliminate per-call H2D weight copies

design.invariant: every xcuda_matmul_f64 B operand is a transposed weight whose host pointer is stable for the engine lifetime (bundle storage / owned dequantized tensors) and immutable after load
design.cache: host pointer -> device buffer unordered_map under mutex; first use uploads, later calls reuse
design.transient: activations (A) and outputs (C) stay per-call; single shared cuBLAS handle instead of per-call create/destroy
design.release: xcuda_release_weights() frees all cached buffers + handle on engine unload — stale pointers can never alias new tensors

validation.cuda_path: test_cpp_cuda_opt_in_logits_parity / generation_parity exercise the resident-weight path on real GPU — logits parity 1e-6, greedy token-exact incl. generate_batch

remaining: device-resident KV — only meaningful once attention runs on-device (GPU attention kernels; blocked on nvcc/MSVC-18 or newer toolchain)
bf16 GEMM and custom kernels (same toolchain blocker)
